description: This file defines a customizable Modal component for a React project, including styling, draggable and resizable features, and integration with Ant Design modal.

methods.name: BaseModal
methods.description: A wrapper around AntdModal that disables mask transition animation.

methods.name: StyledModal
methods.description: A styled component based on BaseModal with custom CSS for modal appearance and behavior.

methods.name: defaultResizableConfig
methods.description: Provides default configuration for the resizable modal, including min/max dimensions and enabled resize directions.

methods.name: CustomModal
methods.description: Main React component implementing a modal with optional dragging and resizing, customizable footer, and integrated with Ant Design.
